# Seed external message filling with a CR template without prompting.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-25T18:42:46Z'

cd repo
git init
git add .shamhub CHANGE_TEMPLATE.md
git commit -m Initial
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login
git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RECORD=$WORK/invocation

# With multiple templates, fill picks the first without asking.
git add one.txt
gs branch create default -m Default -m 'Default body'
gs --no-prompt branch submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #1'
cmp $WORK/invocation/draft $WORK/golden/default-draft.txt

# The configured template overrides the default during batch submission too.
git config spice.submit.template CHANGE_TEMPLATE.md
git add two.txt
gs branch create configured -m Configured -m 'Configured body'
gs --no-prompt stack submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #2'
cmp $WORK/invocation/draft $WORK/golden/configured-draft.txt

# An unavailable configured template warns and falls back without a prompt.
git config spice.submit.template missing.md
git add three.txt
gs branch create fallback -m Fallback -m 'Fallback body'
gs --no-prompt branch submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Template "missing.md" not found'
stderr 'Created #3'
cmp $WORK/invocation/draft $WORK/golden/fallback-draft.txt

# The edited body is used without appending another copy of the template.
shamhub dump changes
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/golden/changes.json

-- repo/.shamhub/CHANGE_TEMPLATE.md --
## Default template

Describe the change.
-- repo/CHANGE_TEMPLATE.md --
## Configured template

Describe the tests.
-- repo/one.txt --
one
-- repo/two.txt --
two
-- repo/three.txt --
three
-- message.txt --
{{.Draft}}
-- golden/default-draft.txt --
Default

Default body

## Default template

Describe the change.
-- golden/configured-draft.txt --
Configured

Configured body

## Configured template

Describe the tests.
-- golden/fallback-draft.txt --
Fallback

Fallback body

## Default template

Describe the change.
